meta.title: Fix O(n²) performance issue in CLI datatype declaration processing
meta.body_summary: Fix O(n²) performance in Z3 CLI datatype declarations by using lazy hash table for constructor name lookups, reducing complexity from O(n²) to O(n).

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed O(n²) CLI datatype processing with lazy hash table after initial flawed batch approach; maintainer guided towards correct solution and merged after two revisions.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 180 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small focused algorithm fix. It fits a targeted performance PR that merged after iterative review-driven improvements.

review_details.concern_detail: NikolajBjorner pointed out that the batch initialization still performed O(n²) linear searches, thus not fixing the root cause; agent then implemented lazy hash table.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix O(n²) complexity in CLI datatype declaration processing, reducing execution time dramatically (e.g., 14s → ~10ms for 100k constructors).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent initially failed to address the real bottleneck (still O(n²) due to linear lookups), requiring maintainer to point out the flaw and suggest hash table; after revision, agent correctly implemented hash table and small-datatype optimization.

detection_detail.code_reading: NikolajBjorner identified that batch initialization still had O(n²) linear searches, and later suggested using linear scan for small datatypes and passing func_decl* instead of name.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes profiler mention and expected speedups but no reproducible benchmark; maintainer accepted after code review.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After initial batch fix was rejected, agent implemented lazy hash table; after further review, added linear search optimization for small datatypes and postcondition assertion.

core_change_summary.description: In src/ast/datatype_decl_plugin.cpp, replaced O(n²) linear constructor name lookups with a lazy hash table (dictionary<constructor*>) to achieve O(1) lookup in get_constructor_recognizer and get_constructor_accessors. Also optimized get_constructor_by_name to take func_decl* and use linear scan for small datatype arity <10.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: cmd_context.cpp was modified in first commit to call batch initialization, then reverted in second commit; no lasting performance impact there.
change_trajectory: Initial batch initialization commit (b51832): added util::batch_initialize_constructor_functions with O(n²) linear search inside loop.
Review comment (NikolajBjorner): batch fix still doesn't fix bottleneck.
Second commit (dfdc31): replaced batch with lazy hash table dictionary<constructor*> for O(1) lookups, removed batch function.
Further comment: suggested passing func_decl* instead of name and linear scan for small arity.
Third commit (2788b8): optimized get_constructor_by_name to take func_decl*, added linear scan for arity <10, and SASSERT postcondition.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out that batch initialization still uses O(n²) linear searches and does not fix the original bottleneck.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot replaced batch with lazy hash table (dfdc31).

review_signals.summary: Acknowledged the flaw; announced implementation of lazy hash table for O(1) lookups.
Requested using func_decl* parameter in get_constructor_by_name, linear scan for arity<10, and non-null postcondition.
Confirmed implementation of requested get_constructor_by_name changes.
APPROVED after all fixes (no body text).
